issues.description: Modular bias in Fisher-Yates shuffle: `randomValues[i] % (i + 1)` is not uniformly distributed. Must use rejection sampling for fair card distribution in a GTO training tool.

GameService reimplements ~250 lines of game state logic (applyAction, isStreetComplete, isHandComplete, etc.) instead of delegating to the pure functional state machine in engine/state-machine.ts. Two divergent rule implementations with differing blind sizes (0.5/1 vs 1/2) and edge-case handling.
No test files exist. T-009 (engine unit tests), T-015 (BOT behavioral tests), and T-046 (E2E integration tests) are completely missing.
vitest is missing from devDependencies despite being specified in T-001 scaffold and tech stack.
T-045 not implemented: No IndexedDB availability detection, no error recovery Modal, no Toast warnings for engine failures.
Pot calculation at showdown uses per-street currentBet (reset each street) instead of cumulative total hand contributions. Side pots incorrect for multi-street all-in scenarios.
Duplicate hand evaluation and combinations() code. Should import from engine/hand-evaluator.ts instead of reimplementing.
uuid package is a dependency but never used. ID generation uses Date.now() + Math.random() instead of RFC4122 UUIDs as specified by the API spec.
Multiple eslint-disable for `any` types in preflop cache. Should use typed interfaces or `unknown`.
